headline: Completed-protocol history safeguards, Stash vial accuracy, and discoverable nasal spray inventory

changes.title: Stop future Upcoming entries for completed protocols
changes.detail: Explicitly completed protocols no longer create future Upcoming occurrences or due reminders, while preserving past logged doses, attributed history and subsequently active protocol records.

changes.title: Show the correct usable vial and source details in Stash
changes.detail: Preserve blend vial numbering and sealed-only expiry, choose the earliest usable OPEN vial expiry correctly, exclude depleted OPEN vials from next usable stock, and show the remaining 8mg OPEN vial instead of an Empty 0mg card.

changes.title: Make existing nasal spray inventory discoverable in Log Dose
changes.detail: When an archived compound has a saved nasal bottle with remaining stock but no specified pump mL per spray, list it as Pump volume missing and open the original Stash bottle editor; never create a replacement bottle or fall back to a fabricated administration.

changes.title: Explain missing pump volume only when saving an incomplete nasal bottle
changes.detail: Open the Add or Adjust nasal spray form without a persistent warning. On blank-pump Save, show a compact theme-aware confirmation with Add pump volume and Save to Stash anyway. No automatic pump estimate, dose log, inventory debit or protocol status change.
changes.screen: Stash / Add nasal spray / Adjust nasal spray

dataImpact: No destructive migration, automatic rewrite, import, unarchive, dose creation, or overwrite of existing browser localStorage (peptide-tracker-html-v1). Historical protocols, logs, vial numbers, exact-source ledger and inventory are preserved. Explicit future user actions continue to use the existing guarded save/writer and dose-confirmation paths; saving an uncalibrated nasal bottle preserves Stash inventory but does not enable dose logging. Isolated full-app DEMO has fictional in-memory state and no live sync.
limitations: Existing nasal spray bottles without a known pump mL-per-spray remain ineligible for nominal spray-dose calculations; users may add measured or documented specifications in their original Stash bottle. Pump output is not clinically calibrated by Nexus.

The existing protected nasal administration writer gate and safeguards are unchanged. Unsupported prepared formulations or source combinations remain blocked; no clinical calculator certification is claimed.

Physical iPhone usability checks were reported PASS for the PR163 Stash/navigation/completed protocol behaviours and the PR164 missing-pump warning timing/styling/actions. VoiceOver and Dynamic Type were not separately accepted.
User data is stored in the browser; backups remain recommended. No user production dataset was accessed or modified by release engineering.
New version production parity and publication metadata are verified after the approved merge/deployment, not inferred from GitHub merge success alone.
